ardudeck_commands_graph.eachTickWeReReadThe: Each tick we re-read the live vehicle position from AHRS and compute the next bearing fresh. If the link drops the FC just loiters at the last commanded point; when telemetry resumes we pick up from wherever the vehicle actually is - no internal counter to desync.
ardudeck_commands_graph.scriptNeverArmsOrDisarmsChanges: Script never: · arms or disarms · changes flight modes · writes parameters It only issues GUIDED-mode position targets, which the FC ignores when not in GUIDED.
